author: nexo
text:
Kontro RELEASE 🥳 
Kontro is a free Stream Deck replacement for streamers who don’t want to spend money on expensive hardware. Use your primary or spare Android device as your own stream control panel — no extra gear required. Download Kontro and take control of your stream today! 
Grab the Studio and launcher from the download page.
https://github.com/chhhhhhhhhhh111/kontro
